page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the spread). Running head at top left and page number at top right. Main text in one column. Marginal notes in a narrow column at the right, beside the text. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot, below the last line. Left edge of the facing page is not transcribed.

main_text.p: adoramus, & vobis in rebus aliis laeti inferuimus,En obedientiam,neque haec de seipso tantum suisque socijs loquitur Iustinus, cum haec eadem, sub eiusdem Imperio Pontifices Romani tres, Sixtus, Telesphorus, Hyginus, & fecerint in vita, & in morte passi fuerint; & sub Imperatoribus proximis Marco Aurelio, Antonio, & Lucio Vero : Pius & Soter Romani,& Polycarpus Smyrnensis Epis-copus; qui licet (Praeside iubente & rogante) ut per {a}Caesaris fortunam iuraret, facere recusaverit, ne idololatriam incurreret, Caesari tamen, non modo civilem ipse obedientiam praestitit; sed ab aliis praestari praecepit,in Epistola eius nomine ad Philippenses edita; Orate pro Regibus & Potestatibus, & principibus, atq; pro persequentibus & odientibus vos, & pro inimicis Crucis, ut fructus vester manifestus sit in omnibus. Et in {b}Re-sponso ad Proconsulem, (cum ad martyrium ductus esset) illum Magistratum a Deo constitutum, & proinde honorem illi pro dignitate tribuendum libere agnouit: quod & Milites in Imperatoris exercitu praestitisse constat, pluuia Euseb.li. 4.cap.14. Ibidem vt supra.

page.notes: Left edge of the facing page and the vertical rule at the outer edge are not transcribed. Page number read as 81; the upper-right corner is partly obscured. Possible doubtful readings: "socijs" (printed with a j-form), "odientibus" (printed with a j-form), "Caesaris" and "Epistola" are italic in print. The catchword "mira-" sits on the foot line beside the signature "G".
